title: Scene Data Message
description: Track output payload for MQTT topic scenescape/data/scene/{scene_id}/{thing_type}. Accepts Tracker envelopes and Scene Controller DATA_SCENE messages. Top-level and per-object additionalProperties remain open so detection passthrough metadata and producer-specific metrics can extend the envelope without schema churn.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of track computation

unique_detection_count.description: Scene Controller metric: unique track count for this detection type

rate.description: Optional publish/camera rate passthrough from Scene Controller / detector messages

debug_hmo_start_time.description: Scene Controller debug: handleMovingObject start epoch time

debug_hmo_processing_time.description: Scene Controller debug: handleMovingObject processing duration in seconds

id.description: Persistent track ID (UUID when produced by Tracker; Controller may use other stable string IDs)

category.description: Object category (e.g., person, vehicle). Tracker output uses this field.

type.description: Object category alias used by Scene Controller output (same meaning as category)

translation.description: World position [x, y, z] in meters

size.description: Object size [length, width, height] in meters

metadata.description: Optional passthrough metadata from the originating detection (e.g., reid, gender, age). Keys and values are detector-defined.

confidence.description: Optional detection confidence score in [0, 1]; null when the producer did not supply a score

source.description: Debug aid: which sensor produced this detection (e.g. "lidar"/"camera"), pass-through from the originating detection

visibility.description: Camera IDs whose field of view currently contains this track (pass-through from track producer)

camera_bounds.description: Optional per-camera pixel bounding boxes when the producer supplies them

prev_translation.description: Previous world position [x, y, z] in meters when available

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the track was first observed

frame_count.description: Number of frames this track has been observed
